safety: preparation never issues or consumes publication capability
nonready social channel skips provider send, other channels and source recovery continue
final mode revalidates all independent gates
no bypass of consent, identity, uniqueness or protected branch
no new writer, cron or duplicate system

status_contract.prepared: ready_for_final_recheck is not a provider post or a publication guarantee
status_contract.blocked: same original source owner repairs next hourly run
status_contract.live: independent exact provider ID readback only

target: For every scheduled business day all four channels must obtain independent provider/public live proof. Goal, not a promise; every missing proof is a durable, same-owner recovery obligation.

linkedin_company.ready: unique source, original reviewer PASS, company OAuth, measured CTA
linkedin_company.result: immutable share URN plus independently verified provider content
linkedin_company.when_not_ready: original company editorial/source owner repairs next regular run without duplicate

linkedin_personal.ready: authentic personal source and existing owner authorization, exact SHA and duplicate gates
linkedin_personal.result: immutable original person share URN plus independently authorized GET exact id, author and copy
linkedin_personal.when_ack_without_get: never re-send, original provider reconciling owner checks original account and scope; record restricted provider boundary and demand real authorization if needed

instagram.ready: frozen day winner plus source-led Mira producer claim, original cost/asset/media checks, exact 1080x1920 SHA, Mira face >=0.940 at start/middle/end
instagram.result: original Meta/Composio media ID and permalink independently exact-readback
instagram.when_waiting_asset: original Mira producer claims existing job, creates/validates genuinely suitable media with already-approved capacity and no repeated rejected source or weakened gate

blog.ready: fresh primary-date source, reader-ready copy, genuinely authorized editorial release
blog.result: protected GitHub build, merge, Netlify public article URL and exact public content readback
blog.when_no_approval: original editorial approver checks content and uses approved release channel, never writes synthetic approved_at

life_cycle.before_deadline: original owner prepares content/review/media and repairs bounded failures
life_cycle.before_send: exact hash, actual provider permissions, idempotency and final independent review
life_cycle.after_send: independent exact provider ID/URL readback; if ACK-only reconcile never resend
life_cycle.after_proof: measure reach/leads/orders only from verified sources; learn and apply prevention on next content

alert_and_prevention.on_missing: write actual source observation to original ONE BRAIN and Heartbeat; assign existing channel owner; rerun bounded corrective path on next original scheduler #140; do not disable scheduler or alternate publisher
alert_and_prevention.on_technical_failure: source-level prevention, regression and protected release with independent runtime readback
alert_and_prevention.human_boundary: request real consent/editorial authorization without inventing it
alert_and_prevention.green_assertion: all expected channels independently LIVE_PROVEN, exact timestamp/id/URL/author/content and measured proof; false-green prohibited
